summary: @servicetitan/contentful-proxy preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed (`_0x...` identifiers wrapped through a helper indirection object) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun release archive if `bun` is not already on PATH, chmods it 0755, and then invokes it via `execFileSync('bun', [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)` against a sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) that begins with a shuffled ~1000-entry string-array plus a rotating string-array function — the standard obfuscator.io shape used to hide control flow and network destinations. The package's stated purpose is a Contentful React/mobx client, which has no need for a second language runtime nor an obfuscated 727KB blob executed under it. Using an alternate runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code, and the payload runs automatically on `npm install` with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
